title: LureGuard Detection Coverage
description: What should have fired and did not. Wazuh shows what fired; it cannot show the gap. GFA-7.

list.name: tactic
list.label: Tactic
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT tactic FROM attack_rule_map ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Techniques seen
panels.description: Distinct ATT&CK techniques with at least one matching event over the selected range. Counts what the fleet actually produced, not what the ruleset could theoretically detect.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT m.technique) AS techniques_seen
FROM events e
JOIN attack_rule_map m ON m.wazuh_rule_id = e.wazuh_rule_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  AND (NULLIF('${agent_id}', '') IS NULL OR e.agent_id = NULLIF('${agent_id}', ''))
  AND ('${tactic}' = '$__all' OR m.tactic = '${tactic}')

panels.title: Techniques dark
panels.description: Mapped techniques with zero matching events over the selected range. These are the blind spots — a rule exists, and nothing has tripped it here.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS techniques_dark FROM (
  SELECT m.technique
  FROM attack_rule_map m
  WHERE ('${tactic}' = '$__all' OR m.tactic = '${tactic}')
  GROUP BY m.technique
  HAVING NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM events e
    WHERE e.wazuh_rule_id = ANY (
      SELECT wazuh_rule_id FROM attack_rule_map x WHERE x.technique = m.technique
    )
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
    AND (NULLIF('${agent_id}', '') IS NULL OR e.agent_id = NULLIF('${agent_id}', ''))
  )
) d

panels.title: Rules mapped
panels.description: Point-in-time: Wazuh rules carrying an ATT&CK mapping. Projection of core/attack_map.json, reloaded at Core startup — not editable here.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT wazuh_rule_id) AS rules_mapped FROM attack_rule_map

panels.title: Silent channels
panels.description: Channels that produced events historically but none over the selected range. A broken log path is invisible in Wazuh; this is the panel that surfaces it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS silent_channels FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT channel FROM events
  EXCEPT
  SELECT DISTINCT channel FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
) s

panels.title: Techniques observed over time
panels.description: Distinct techniques tripping per interval. A drop is either quiet traffic or a broken pipeline — cross-check against Silent channels.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(e.ts, '$__interval') AS time,
       count(DISTINCT m.technique) AS techniques
FROM events e
JOIN attack_rule_map m ON m.wazuh_rule_id = e.wazuh_rule_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  AND (NULLIF('${agent_id}', '') IS NULL OR e.agent_id = NULLIF('${agent_id}', ''))
  AND ('${tactic}' = '$__all' OR m.tactic = '${tactic}')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Dark techniques — mapped but never observed
panels.description: The blind spots. A rule covers each of these and nothing has tripped it in the selected range: either the attack has not occurred, or the log path feeding that rule is broken. Wazuh cannot show this, because it only knows what did fire.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT m.technique AS "Technique",
       m.tactic AS "Tactic",
       count(DISTINCT m.wazuh_rule_id) AS "Rules covering it",
       min(m.description) AS "Example rule"
FROM attack_rule_map m
WHERE ('${tactic}' = '$__all' OR m.tactic = '${tactic}')
GROUP BY m.technique, m.tactic
HAVING NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM events e
  WHERE e.wazuh_rule_id = ANY (
    SELECT wazuh_rule_id FROM attack_rule_map x WHERE x.technique = m.technique
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  AND (NULLIF('${agent_id}', '') IS NULL OR e.agent_id = NULLIF('${agent_id}', ''))
)
ORDER BY 2, 1

panels.title: Coverage by tactic
panels.description: Seen versus mapped per ATT&CK tactic. A tactic at 0 seen is entirely dark for this fleet.

targets.rawSql:
WITH seen AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.technique, m.tactic
  FROM events e
  JOIN attack_rule_map m ON m.wazuh_rule_id = e.wazuh_rule_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(e.ts)
    AND (NULLIF('${agent_id}', '') IS NULL OR e.agent_id = NULLIF('${agent_id}', ''))
)
SELECT m.tactic AS "Tactic",
       count(DISTINCT m.technique) AS "Mapped",
       count(DISTINCT s.technique) AS "Seen",
       round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT s.technique) / NULLIF(count(DISTINCT m.technique), 0)) AS "Covered %"
FROM attack_rule_map m
LEFT JOIN seen s ON s.tactic = m.tactic AND s.technique = m.technique
GROUP BY m.tactic
ORDER BY 4 NULLS FIRST, 1

panels.title: Channels gone quiet
panels.description: Channels that have produced events before but none in the selected range, with how long ago they were last heard from. This is the ingestion blind spot — a silent decoder looks identical to a quiet network.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT channel AS "Channel",
       max(ts) AS "Last event",
       round(extract(epoch FROM (now() - max(ts))) / 3600.0, 1) AS "Hours quiet",
       count(*) AS "Events all time"
FROM events
GROUP BY channel
HAVING max(ts) < now() - interval '1 hour'
ORDER BY 3 DESC
